title: Show HN: SelfClaw – Self-hosted multi-model AI chat with OpenAI-compatible API
author: alanzj
raw_text: SelfClaw aggregates multiple LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API. Built with Python, Streamlit, and FastAPI. MIT licensed.
summary: SelfClaw is an open-source project that allows you to self-host your own AI chat service. Its main feature is aggregating various LLM providers, such as different models from OpenAI or other companies, and presenting them all through a single API that is compatible with OpenAI's standard. It's built using Python, Streamlit for the user interface, and FastAPI for the backend API. As you explore LLMs, you'll find that different models excel at different tasks or have varying costs. SelfClaw offers a practical way to experiment with and switch between multiple models seamlessly, without rewriting your application code. Its self-hosted nature gives you control over your data and infrastructure. You could set up SelfClaw locally and integrate a couple of different LLM providers, then make requests to its unified API to compare responses.
why: Manages multiple LLMs via one API, offering flexibility and control.
